name: Volumetric Ray Casting with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A basic volumetric ray casting application that visualizes volumetric data stored in RAW format. It uses GPU rendering and supports multithreaded rendering via OpenMP pragmas. The core technique involves casting rays through a voxel grid and interpolating scalar values at sample points using trilinear interpolation based on the 8 corners of the enclosing voxel cell.
